title: IGE - In Game Editor
description: This plugin allowed you to edit your config files inside minecraft without going into the files
body:
🛠️ IGE: In-Game Editor 🛠️
IGE is a powerful, lightweight administrative tool designed for server owners and developers who need to make real-time configuration changes without ever leaving the game or touching an FTP client. 📁✨

Stop toggling between your console and your text editor. With IGE, you can browse, read, and edit your plugin files directly through a sleek chat-based interface and intuitive Anvil UIs! 💻🎮

✨ Core Features
📂 Plugin File Explorer: Navigate through your /plugins folder with a custom GUI. If it's a folder, you can open it. If it's a config, you can edit it!

🌈 Smart YAML Syntax Highlighting: View your config files in chat with beautiful, logic-based coloring. Keys, strings, booleans, and comments are all visually distinct for easy reading.

🔨 Anvil-Based Editing: Click any line to open it in an Anvil UI. Type your changes, click the result, and you're done! No more messy chat commands for long strings.

➕ Dynamic Line Management: Need to add a new setting or remove a defunct one? Add or delete lines with a single click.

🔄 Auto-Reload Integration: IGE intelligently attempts to reload the target plugin the moment you save a change, making your workflow seamless.

📖 Pagination Support: Effortlessly scroll through large configuration files with built-in navigation buttons.

🚀 How to Use
Type /ige to open the Plugin Selector. 🖱️

Select the plugin folder you want to explore. 📂

Click the file (YAML, JSON, TXT, etc.) you want to modify. 📄

Edit: Click the line number or text to modify it via Anvil. 🔨

Add: Click [+ Add Line] to insert a new entry. ➕

Delete: Click the [x] next to any line to remove it instantly. ❌

📜 Permissions & Commands
/ige — Opens the main plugin selection menu.

/ige editor   — Jump directly to a specific file.

Required Permission: ige.admin (or Op status)

⚠️ Note: This tool provides direct access to your plugin configurations. Ensure only trusted administrators have access to the /ige command!
